Every unique item that can drop in D2R-XL 2012. Click a column to sort it, or type in a table's search box to filter.

== Tiered uniques ==
Tiered uniques exist on every tier of their base (tiers 1 to 6) and grow stronger with it.

{{#cargo_query:tables=Items
|fields=_pageName=Item,base=Base,type=Type,COUNT(*)=Tiers,MIN(lvlreq)=Lowest level,MAX(lvlreq)=Highest level
|where=quality='unique' AND tier<>'' AND tier<>'sacred'
|group by=_pageName
|order by=type,_pageName
|format=dynamic table
|limit=5000
|rows per page=25
}}

== Sacred uniques ==
Sacred uniques sit on sacred bases and drop only in the highest difficulty.

{{#cargo_query:tables=Items
|fields=_pageName=Item,base=Base,type=Type,lvlreq=Required level
|where=quality='unique' AND tier='sacred'
|order by=type,_pageName
|format=dynamic table
|limit=5000
|rows per page=25
}}

== Other uniques ==
Jewels, charms, rings, amulets and other uniques without tiers.

{{#cargo_query:tables=Items
|fields=_pageName=Item,base=Base,type=Type,lvlreq=Required level
|where=quality='unique' AND (tier='' OR tier IS NULL)
|order by=type,_pageName
|format=dynamic table
|limit=5000
|rows per page=25
}}

Also: [[Cornerstone of the World]], a jewel with 149 variants.
